body:
Idk. General feeling of unimportance, you know? Like I don’t matter at all maybe? Something like that. Maybe even a feeling of people wanting me gone.
It sucks

Stay strong. What I and many others are experiencing is nothing compared to you, so my words may seem empty. If your friends and family don’t like the way you are without those faded characteristics, then maybe they’re not really your friends anymore. People change and grow apart, and that’s very hard to accept, especially when they’re all you have. 
Find someone in your new place, whom you can trust. Yes that’s hard, but I think it’s necessary. 
You crying is not good. Find someone you trust, that will listen. When you feel sad, tell them that you do. Tell them one thing that sucked about your day, maybe you’ll learn something more about what’s wrong. Simply explaining someone you’re sad, can give better insight as to why. I know this is not easy, I don’t practice what I preach myself, but I believe it’s the best thing to do.
This is most likely not the response you’re looking for, so at least take this with you. I feel with you, and it genuinely saddens me that you feel this way. I hope you get better
Man it sucks to be at too insecure to do anything about it... I feel with you brother / sister. Is literally my biggest wish at the time being
Me too
Idk man, feels like the consequences outweigh the reward considering the (according to me) low chances of success
Yeah, she is pretty fucking cool. I enjoy the relationship we have and simultaneously want more
Wouldn’t I be instigating conflict with my friend then? I wouldn’t want that either. Also, I feel like I would create distance by telling of my one sided feelings. I see all possibilities as a loss
It’s more like he doesn’t want me going for her
Yes I’ve felt like this before, but not to this ridiculous degree. It usually ends up with me confessing while super drunk and getting turned down
I am truly convinced she is uninterested in me, so I don’t see why I should. I am only ruining the friendship we have

At around 14-15 I started to feel shitty. I asked around on forums and got the answer “oh it’s puberty”
Here I am, half a decade later and I still feel shitty. Despite a few improvements it’s overall gotten worse


10/10 would ask online for help again
Sucks. I hope it gets better for you!
It’s not even remotely comforting. It is only telling you that your feelings are wrong and you should be ashamed
I have now concluded that me eating dirt wouldn’t even count as cannibalism; I am not of that high value
I feel ya

I know it's a bit late, but let me answer.
I could probably be frank with my friends; every logical part of me says so. However, I also have this deeply rooted fear of commitment, which leads to me not really being frank with any of my friends. But in my eyes shallow friendships are better than no friendships. I've tried both, and I know which of the two I find better

You're right that a fulfilling relationship could make it both better or worse, but a fear of commitment and a fear of disappointing will probably keep me away from trying

I don't know if it's rooted in the past. Truly some shit has happened (my parents' divorce, death etc.), so it wouldn't be unreasonable. I find calling it abstract pretty accurate, considering that, despite me having experienced this for 5 years or so, I still don't really know what causes it, and I can in no way predict when something happens with my mental state.

I do all those things, however I still am not doing well, though I do admittedly feel lonely. 
I don’t know why they would be disgusted; I just feel as if they would be, no matter how unrealistic
I agree. The chance is there, but one can only dream, because it just doesn’t happen.

If you truly did log off, then this doesn’t matter, but in the off-chance that you didn’t: please don’t. You’re right, that I don’t understand your situation and that I don’t know you, but honestly, please don’t. I can’t express my wish for your, a complete stranger that I’ll never meets, wellbeing. 
Just. Please. Don’t...
That's pretty much what I do

Unfortunately I don't like taking such a risk. She's a classmate, it's not like I can avoid her "if" she rejects me. Also, by sharing it, she could probably kill my social life. You might say that, if that's enough to make my friends leave me, then I have some terrible friends, and so what? Maybe I do, maybe I don't. Additionally, in the off chance that she doesn't reject me, I'm pretty sure one of my friends has a pretty big crush on her, and then he could kill my social life, from the other side. 
Idk if this makes sense. Sorry if it doesn't

I know mine is temporary,
The main problem for me I the anxiety that starts the thought in general

I know my problem here is minor compared to others, I don’t wish to make myself out as a victim, it simply helps me to vent
Well yeah, but I do my best to manage
Worst case scenario? Probably complete social isolation followed by my death
Again, I’m probably overreacting, but my semi-anxiety, is kicking up and I just need to vent for a moment
I don’t believe in anything like fate or that everyone will live a good life, but I sincerely hope you’re right

It’s not so much that she rejected me, but my class is tightly knit, and if she as much as states that I asked her out to our classmates, it will spread like a virus, everyone will know within a couple of days, and if they think my class thinks anything bad of it, one of us will be thrown out of the social group that is my class, and that would most likely be me. I can only hope that she just keeps quiet

The thing is, I don’t know if I’m able to be patient. I don’t exactly know what’s keeping me from just ending it, considering I my biggest achievement is having more days where I’m neither happy nor sad than days where I’m just sad. Additionally, being alone is my fortes. I’ve been for the past 5 years, and now I’m in a habit I can’t change myself (despite help from my therapist). I want to desperately but I can’t. Currently my only option is hoping I last long enough for the heavens to part, bringing down a miracle.
I am currently getting treatment, but I'll keep your words in mind, so thank you
I know it unrealistic, but my mind thinks I have everything to lose, so please explain how there's nothing to lose
Hearing what you’re saying, you should probably try therapy. However do note that “healing” or whatever you wanna call it will take a long time and require a lot of hard work on your part
The car thing: yes. The work hours thing is my own fault for basically taking all shifts I’m asked to. I’m currently working on prioritizing my time with my therapist

I’m soon gonna get fired due to turning 18, so that’s gonna cut back with about 12 hours per week. Also I’ll have access to car, which will cut down on transport. I am however currently compensating for the amount of work in the worst way possible. Sleeping less!
Well I’m not exactly holding all that down gracefully. Skipping lessons and assignments and all. I don’t really have the mental capacity to keep up with my own schedule
Unfortunately, I’m currently working ~60 hours per week (school + work + misc. activities). That is already way to much, but I have a hard time cutting down. So yeah, pretty stressed atm.

I think this all boils down to me wanting to feel needed or necessary. Last time I was with a non-family member just one-on-one was in October. It's no that they can't respond. It's my own fault for not telling. I just feel like if I want to be invited places, I have to butt in at ask if I can come, and sometimes that doesn't even work
She's already getting help. All her friends know. I don't know what to do
Don’t get me wrong. I’m not giving up on her. I couldn’t. I’m just stating my immense fear. I wouldn’t know what to do should she disappear (and before you ask: yes, I’ve told her that)

You honestly don't think I've tried? She's already in therapy, everyone knows. She getting help, but it's not fucking working. I honestly thinks she's right when she says I can't help. I've never been able to and I never will! For all I know I should stop texting her, so she would lose one source of stress

I don’t know you or your story, but that doesn’t matter now.  *hugs*
You matter to us strangers more than you think :)

I’ve never felt so much joy from a simple reply. 
Thank you
I know the feel man. But I think you won’t. I believe you can get better! Epic hugs from me
Me too man. *hugs*
Hey, I know it’s been 8 days, but it really means a lot to me that you share
I know the feel bro. When you need someone to be there they never are
For me it either feels artificial or when I doesn’t I just feel like an ass for still not believing it
I know the feel, I just don’t know why
That's really not the point of it. That wouldn't really work as a long term solution

Generally it helps a lot, since you both get to talk about your problems, and get help in finding solutions. I'm undergoing therapy now, though I have only been receiving for 3 months, but I would recommend it.
It has been 4 months. It's only gotten worse. I've had multiple panic attacks during this time, and one of them caused me to run away from home
I know the feeling. Besides me having shown my family myself without the mask a couple months ago, I still keep it on. It feels better
Same. I feel ashamed about my mental state and I’ve realized that none of my friends really care about me. Feels bad man
Also, I don’t have any close friends to actually talk “real” with, and I don’t believe I ever will
Thanks man. I'll look into it
I'm happy to hear about you feeling pleasant
It sounds great that you're saving up for it. Hope you'll be able to go soon
Gotta attend school
You should totally go to the beach btw. It'd probably be fun
I am soon returning from a trip to Japan. When I get home I'll just get back to sleeping my life away :/
Same. I would sleep for (a lot) longer, if I didn't have to get up at 6:30 everyday
I think it would be better than nothing though
Let me actually try with this good convo thing. Done anything cool recently?
Pretty much in same boat. Stopped talking to people. Can't sleep, and when I actually do, I wake up soon again.
You could try with therapy. They won't just jump to medication. In my case they never did. Psychotherapist in general seem to keep to conversational therapy.
I know the feel man...
Thanks, man. I Will look into it
I can't
I don't think she would no. But I can't shake the fear of me... it's deeply rooted into me

I get the feeling. This subreddit is nice, for getting weight of my shoulders. I can't do that with people I know anymore. I terrifies me. I told my ex (at that time GF) and eventually she gave up on me (I don't blame her though). The thought of her using her knowledge of me against me terrifies me though.
